description: The bar chart on the left illustrates the Fleiss Kappa values for inter-annotator agreement, with the x-axis representing different levels of ambiguity standard deviation (Ambiguity Std) and the y-axis showing the Fleiss Kappa values. The bars are color-coded in blue, with the highest value at 0.88 for the lowest Ambiguity Std (0.0), indicating the highest agreement among annotators. The values decrease as the Ambiguity Std increases, with the lowest agreement (0.03) at the highest Ambiguity Std (0.94). The bar chart on the right compares the Fleiss Kappa values to the sample-level maximum ambiguity values. The highest Fleiss Kappa value is 0.89 for the lowest maximum ambiguity (1), and it decreases to 0.46 for the highest maximum ambiguity (2). The lowest Fleiss Kappa value is 0.23 for the highest maximum ambiguity (3). The bars are also color-coded in blue, and the values are displayed above each bar. The chart does not include any visual emphasis on specific bars or annotations.
